title: 第84章 你防的不是人

第84章 你防的不是人-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安微微抬头向刚刚闪现的方向瞥了一眼，红色的字体再次出现，在右边中间偏上位置。

接着他很自然地拐进了单元门。

楼道里光线比较昏暗，墙壁上同样是贴满了各种花花绿绿的小广告——疏通管道的，搬家拉货的，还有一张“五分钟开锁”。

顾承安看了一眼那张广告一眼。

五分钟？效率不行啊。

他放轻脚步上楼。

二楼某户门缝里传出电视剧的声音，挺大的——“坦白从宽，抗拒从严……”

“挺应景的！”顾承安心里想到。

三楼很安静，很快四楼便到了。

红色的标签，就是在走廊尽头最里面那扇门里。

现在字体大多了，能看出具体信息了。

【姓名：马文昌。】

【职业：黑色掮客/绑匪/走私】

他观察了会儿，标签纹丝没动，从高度判断，大概率还在睡觉。

顾承安慢慢的靠近门口，上下打量了一下这扇木门，配的是最普通的弹子锁。

这锁防的不是人，防的是风。

他从系统空间取出老朋友——润滑油，对准锁芯滴了一些进去，然后放回空间。

再取出开锁工具。

张力扳手探入，勾针跟进。

手指微调。

第一颗弹子，到位。

第二颗。

第三颗。

“咔。”

耗时七秒，让顾承安不由得又想起了刚才的小广告。

凝神观察了一下，眼镜片上的标签还是一点没动。

开锁工具立马收回空间，92改手枪同步取出，左手推门，右脚迈入，一气呵成。

肘部顺势磕在门边的开关上。

屋子里一下子变得亮堂起来。

房间不大，十五平米撑死，一张单人床靠墙，折叠桌上摆着两桶泡面和一部手机。

床上的人被一连串声响惊醒，本能地坐起来，手往枕头底下摸去——

“不许动。”

Gu Chengan raised his head slightly and glanced in the direction he just flashed. The red font appeared again, in the upper middle position on the right.

Then he turned into the unit door naturally.

The light in the corridor is relatively dim, and the walls are also covered with various colorful advertisements - for clearing pipes, for moving goods, and for "unlocking in five minutes."

Gu Chengan glanced at the advertisement.

Five minutes?The efficiency is not good.

He went upstairs with gentle steps.

The voice of a TV series came from the crack of a door on the second floor. It was quite loud - "If you confess, you will be lenient, if you resist, you will be strict..."

"It's quite appropriate!" Gu Chengan thought in his heart.

The third floor was very quiet, and soon we arrived at the fourth floor.

The red label is in the innermost door at the end of the corridor.

Now that the fonts are larger, specific information can be seen.

[Name: Ma Wenchang.】

[Occupation: Black Broker/Kidnapper/Smuggling]

He observed it for a while, but the label didn't move at all. Judging from the height, he was probably still sleeping.

Gu Chengan slowly approached the door and looked at the wooden door up and down. It was equipped with the most common pinball lock.

This lock does not protect against people, but against the wind.

He took out his old friend lubricating oil from the system space, pointed some at the lock cylinder, and put it back into the space.

Then take out the lock picking tool.

The tension wrench reaches in and the hook pin follows.

Finger fine-tuning.

The first marble is in place.

The second one.

The third one.

"Click."

It took seven seconds, and Gu Chengan couldn't help but think of the small advertisement just now.

After observing carefully, the label on the spectacle lens was still not moved at all.

The lock-picking tool immediately retracted the space, the 92 modified pistol was taken out simultaneously, the door was pushed open with the left hand, and the right foot was stepped in, all in one go.

His elbow hit the switch next to the door.

The room suddenly became brighter.

The room was not big, just fifteen square meters, with a single bed against the wall and two buckets of instant noodles and a mobile phone on the folding table.

The person on the bed was awakened by a series of noises. He sat up instinctively and reached under the pillow——

"Don't move."
